name: redspacem-sdk
description: RedSpaceM SDK — build multiplayer gamemodes for Cyberpunk 2077 servers (TypeScript packages + freeroam example).

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/@redspacem/server-types build && bun run --cwd packages/@redspacem/rpc build && bun run --cwd packages/@redspacem/client-types build && bun run --cwd packages/@redspacem/di build && bun run --cwd packages/@redspacem/browser-types build && bun run --cwd packages/@redspacem/testing build && bun run --cwd examples/freeroam build
